svg.title: BTS Restructure Architecture — 4 Phase Plan
svg.desc: Full system architecture showing current monolith problems and 4-phase restructure plan
svg.text: Fixes RAM + CPU bottleneck. Zero UI change. Zero protocol change.
Crash protection: .pkt files survive restart → zero data loss.
Rename to .processing = atomic claim (no duplicate processing between workers)
UI refresh rate fixed at 2/sec regardless of device count. Fixes dashboard freeze.
No event chain. No per-packet StateHasChanged. All existing pages and components unchanged in behaviour.
DeviceCircuit.razor: param type changes, field paths minor update, render templates unchanged.
Separate Windows Service + Blazor web. REST API + SignalR hub between them.
